text: Initialization proof/tracking shall match every permitted alias and integer view, reset per allocation lifetime, and remain private/bounded. At merges a definite-initialization proof shall use the intersection of incoming initialized sets; loops shall use a sound fixed point. May-alias stores shall establish only bytes proven written.
